frame: meadow region frame = meadow_greybox_v0_8.glb (game/glTF, Y-up). M6=(0.2,6.5,-25.6)
origin_meaning: pos = transport_balloon root (basket bottom centre). Girl controllerRoot = node basket_floor / stand_point (+0.10 m Y).
yaw_meaning: bearing of balloon +Z forward = atan2(dx,dz) in degrees; node rotation = Ry(yawDeg)

balloonSkyOffset.applies_to: env_skycity.glb root (production: creator-build-project/assets/bundles/region_skycity/env_skycity.glb, Draco; anchors cross-checked against handoff/.../skycity-B/r2/deps/skycity_decoded.glb)

sceneSwitch.rule: meadow scene (env_meadow) rendered only for t < meadowOff_t; env_skycity rendered only for t >= skyCityOn_t; meadowOff_t <= skyCityOn_t, both inside the full-screen cloud window, so the two scenes are never rendered at the same moment
sceneSwitch.preload: load region_skycity (inactive) during the climb, before meadowOff_t; destroy/unload region_meadow after meadowOff_t

visibilityRules.skyCity: env_skycity hidden for t < 11.6 (inside the full-screen cloud), shown after; no geometry cut
visibilityRules.citySeaClouds: cloud groups clouds_city_sea, clouds_floor and clouds_floor_puff follow skyCity visibility (on from skyCityOn_t)
visibilityRules.transitClouds: clouds_deck, clouds_deck_loose, clouds_far, clouds_horizon: on for the whole transit
visibilityRules.dayDome: env_sky_dome (island day dome) for the whole transit = exactly one sky layer (no swap needed in v2; runtime: camera-following)
visibilityRules.nightDome: transit_night_dome only; env_sky_dome and meadow_sky_dome disabled

night.M_transit_cloud_emissive: set emissiveFactor to [0,0,0] at night (clouds stay opaque, lit by moon/ambient only)

visibilityRules.girl: girl stands on balloon node basket_floor / stand_point; the render stand-in faces the 离地 camera (yaw -76.6 deg relative to the basket)
